label: Brent Crude
delta: Climbed to $94.11 on Sep 1 after two tankers were struck near Khasab and the US launched fresh strikes on Iran; extended to $96.11 (+2.12%) by Sep 2 as Iran retaliated against Bahrain, Jordan and Iraq -- roughly a six-week high

label: Hormuz Daily Tanker Transits
contestNote: PortWatch recorded just 3 transits on Aug 23 against an 85/day pre-crisis baseline; Vortexa/Baird Maritime reported only 2 tankers crossing on Aug 25-26. CENTCOM declared shipping lanes 'cleared of Iranian mines and open' on Aug 28, but Straits Daily Brief counted 383 vessels still holding position away from berth (down from 449 a week earlier) and major shipping companies remained unconvinced
deltaNote: Traffic thinned further despite the Aug 26 corridor announcement and Aug 28 mine-clearing claim, neither of which has yet translated into higher transit counts

label: 2026 Global Growth Forecast
contestNote: World Bank warns growth could fall to 1.3% in an adverse energy-shock scenario; IMF's own baseline is more optimistic at 3.1%
